integrity: The result is established by the included proof and reproducible finite tests; no independent scientific validation or exhaustive bibliographic priority determination is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to paired domination of triangular graphs L(K_n) for n>=3, not all Johnson or line graphs. The exact infinite formulas are proved combinatorially; finite checks are supporting tests, and potentially equivalent unindexed prior literature remains a priority risk.
title: Paired domination of triangular graphs: a complete polynomial and minimum-set census
